Section 1 of Executive Order No. 331, dated
July 7, 1950, insofar as it sets up ceiling prices for locally
manufactured canned pineapples, is hereby repealed inas-
much as there is an abundant supply of said commodity.

The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include the
7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.

This Order shall take effect five days after the
date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 14th day of October, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the eighth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINo
President of the Philippines
• By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
